name: Morning
say: The last of the ebb running out of the Gate and light southerly airs outside. A quiet sea to learn the bar on

name: Early afternoon
say: The sea breeze is in at the Gate, 12 knots and building. Outside it is lighter. The flood starts mid afternoon

name: Late afternoon
say: Fifteen knots through the Gate with the flood under it, and the sun going down toward the Farallones

name: After dark
say: The lights are lit. The big ebb of the night is starting: three knots over the bar by one in the morning, and ships in the lanes

name: Monday at first light
say: The ebb easing, a light south-westerly, and the whole day ahead: the time to leave for the islands or for Drakes Bay

name: A fresh afternoon
say: The recorded day was a quiet one out here. This is the same afternoon with twice the wind: 25 knots at the Gate, 10 to 15 outside. Nearer what the coast usually serves
